task.title: Filter corpus samples by sanitation blocker presence
task.objective: Select records by structural blocker-list presence without inferring or rewriting the aggregate sanitation decision
acceptance_criteria: True matches a non-empty sanitation.blockers list
False matches an empty blocker list
Blocker presence and sanitation.passed remain independent predicates
Complete validation and post-filter limits remain unchanged

attempts.summary: Added regressions for present and absent blockers, composition, empty results, invalid values, and invalid records
attempts.diagnostic: The CLI did not recognize has-sanitation-blockers

attempts.summary: Added strict boolean parsing and exact empty versus non-empty blocker-list matching
Simplified the predicate after independent review exposed a blocking boolean-style lint
attempts.diagnostic: Clippy rejected an unnecessarily indirect boolean comparison

outcome.summary: Sampling can distinguish records with sanitation blockers from records without them while retaining aggregate-decision independence

lessons: Structural presence should compare only emptiness and preserve authored aggregate state
Run strict linting during review because equivalent boolean forms are not equally clear
